Figure 59 Student Motivation Distribution 
The motivation levels of students as shown in box-and-whisker diagram in 
Figure 59, show a broad range of responses for the proposed application, while 
with Bitesize responses are more tightly knit as shown by the interquartile 
ranges. This could potentially reflect the varied responses to the applications 
feature set. 
To calculate the motivational values, the observed motivational levels translated 
into numerical equivalents.  
- No motivation: 0 
- Demotivated: 2.5  
- Motivated: 7.5  
- Highly motivated: 10 
The student’s perception of their motivation will then be combined with the 
observed motivational levels, using a 70% weighted bias towards the student, 
using the following equation. 
𝑆𝑡𝑢𝑑𝑒𝑛𝑡 𝑚𝑜𝑡𝑖𝑣𝑎𝑡𝑖𝑜𝑛 = (𝑆𝑡𝑢𝑑𝑒𝑛𝑡′𝑠 𝑝𝑒𝑟𝑐𝑒𝑝𝑡𝑖𝑜𝑛 ×  0.7) + (𝑂𝑏𝑠𝑒𝑟𝑣𝑒𝑟𝑠 𝑝𝑒𝑟𝑐𝑒𝑝𝑡𝑖𝑜𝑛 ×  0.3)
